outcome: lesions observed on brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
cohort: 31 neonates (16 males, 15 females; mean gestational age 39 weeks) who received therapeutic hypothermia for hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy.
finding: Continuous somatosensory evoked potential (SEP) monitoring showed a significant correlation with brain MRI scores and was highly specific and sensitive at predicting MRI abnormalities in neonates with HIE, unlike video electroencephalograms (VEEG).
